data.title: Seagull Point Residences
data.about:
Seagull Point, the latest launch in the prestigious community of District one, offers 1, 2, 3 bedroom apartments with beautiful views of the crystal lagoon. The waterfront addition to D1 has exclusive amenities for the residents including a library, kids play area and an exquisite crystal lagoon with an 8.4 km jogging and cycling track.

Apartments in Seagull Point start at AED 1.14million with 10% on booking and 50% on completion, which is estimated to be in 2021. The apartments are fully furnished with the perfect environment of bespoke living surrounded by vast expanses of greenery. Set in District One, Seagull Point is a part of the lowest density villa freehold development right in the centre of Dubai. District One, a gated exclusive community, offers world-class family-centric amenities, not found anywhere else.
